entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
I want to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's not working properly and I want my money back. This is ridiculous, I've only had it a short time!
Thank you for calling, I understand you'd like to return your VeloBand Pulse. Can I please have your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [Customer Email Address]. Hurry this up, I don't have all day!
Thank you. One moment while I access your order information. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was purchased 15 days ago. According to our policy, the return window for electronics is 10 days.
What?! 10 days? That's insane! I just got it! It's practically brand new! I want a refund. This is terrible customer service!

I understand your frustration. Unfortunately, we are unable to process a full refund since it's outside the return window. However, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase amount. This can be used on any other VeloFit product, including accessories, apparel, or even another VeloBand Pulse if you'd like to try a replacement.
Store credit? Ugh, fine. But what if the next thing I buy breaks too? What kind of guarantee do I have?

Our standard return policy applies to all purchases made with store credit as well, within the respective return window. While I understand your concern, and a policy exception isn't possible at this time, I want to assure you we stand behind our products. The VeloBand Pulse is generally very reliable. Is store credit acceptable in this situation?
Alright, alright, store credit it is then. Just… process it quickly. This whole thing has been a waste of my time.

Certainly. I've processed the store credit to your account. You should see it reflected in your VeloFit account balance immediately. It's the full amount you paid for the VeloBand Pulse. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thanks for actually helping me, even though it took a while.
You're very welcome. We appreciate your business. Have a great day!
